name: Msscorps Co., Ltd.
summary: Msscorps Co., Ltd., founded in 2005 and headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, operates globally, serving markets across Asia, the Americas, and beyond. The company's primary activities include both the testing and analysis of electronic materials, alongside their design, manufacturing, and distribution via retail and wholesale channels. Msscorps provides an extensive range of specialized analytical and repair services. For material analysis, their capabilities encompass advanced techniques such as 3D laser confocal profiling, atomic force microscopy (AFM), Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, and secondary ion mass spectrometry. They also utilize sophisticated equipment like cross-section polishers, SEM/EDS, plasma focused ion beams, dual beam FIB/EDS, and TEM/EDS, including liquid TEM specifically for nanomaterial assessment. Furthermore, the company offers integrated circuit (IC) circuit repair services. Msscorps conducts in-depth failure analysis, employing various methods such as transmission line pulse (TLP), THz-TDR, thermal EMMI, nano prober systems, EMMI/InGaAs, and OBIRCH. Their chemical engineering analysis services feature 2D/3D X-ray imaging, 3D optical microscopy, scanning acoustic tomography, laser decapsulation, and delayering.
